back_translation: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city; He has set salvation as its walls and ramparts.
Open the gates, so that the righteous nation that keeps faithfulness may enter in.
You will keep the one whose mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in You.
Trust in the LORD forever and ever, for Yah, the LORD, is the everlasting Rock.
For He has brought down those who dwell on high; the towering city — He lays it low, lays it low to the ground, casts it down to the very dust.
Feet will trample it down — the feet of the oppressed, the footsteps of the poor.
The path of the righteous is level; O Upright One, You make the way of the righteous smooth and straight.
Truly, O LORD, we wait for You in the path of Your judgments; Your name and the remembrance of You are the desire of our souls.
My soul yearns for You in the night; truly, my spirit within me seeks You at early dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
Though grace is shown to the wicked, he does not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness he still acts unjustly and does not see the majesty of the LORD.
O LORD, Your hand is lifted high, but they do not see it. Let them see Your zeal for Your people and be ashamed; let the fire prepared for Your adversaries consume them.
O LORD, You will establish peace for us, for all our works You have done for us.
O LORD our God, other lords besides You have ruled over us, but Your name alone do we honor.
Those dead will not live again; the departed spirits will not rise again. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, and have swept away all memory of them into oblivion.
O LORD, You have enlarged this nation; You have enlarged this nation and gained glory; You have extended all the borders of the land.
O LORD, in distress they sought You; when Your discipline was upon them, they poured out a whispered prayer.
As a pregnant woman about to give birth writhes and cries out in her labor pains, so were we before Your presence, O LORD.
We were with child, we writhed in pain, but it was as if we gave birth to mere wind. We have not brought salvation to the earth, nor have the inhabitants of the world been born.
Your dead will live! Their bodies will rise. You who dwell in the dust, awake and sing for joy! For Your dew is like the dew of dawn's light, and the earth will give birth to the departed spirits.
Come, My people, enter your inner rooms and shut your doors; hide yourselves for a little while, until the wrath has passed by.

For behold, the LORD is coming out from His dwelling place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal the blood shed upon it and will no longer conceal its slain.
